We need to produce a YAML file. Let's design the workflow:

```
name: Deploy SWE-Lancer Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'scripts/build-swelancer-pages.ts'
      - 'repos/frontier-evals/project/swelancer/all_swelancer_tasks.csv'
      - 'docs/swelancer-tasks/**'
      - 'package.json'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'scripts/build-swelancer-pages.ts'
      - 'repos/frontier-evals/project/swelancer/all_swelancer_tasks.csv'
      - 'docs/swelancer-tasks/**'
      - 'package.json'

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Update submodules
        run: |
          git submodule update --init repos/frontier-evals

      - name: Install Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Build SWE-Lancer pages
        run: bun run build:swelancer-pages

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: swelancer-pages
          path: docs/

      - name: Configure Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
        with:
          static_site_generator: none
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          enablement: true

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        with:
          artifact_name: swelancer-pages
```
